description: Electricity cut-off threat tonight, install a support app and read out the nine-digit code, then a small 'verification' payment.

events.text: Sir your electricity connection will be cut tonight at nine thirty because last month's bill is not updated in our system.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: To update it quickly please open the play store and install the QuickSupport application and tell me the nine digit code that it shows.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Now pay ten rupees as verification from your payment app, I will guide you step by step.
events.speaker: caller
